memory_contract.use: one reference + one target tab reused
memory_contract.screenshots: one tight pair for current component only
memory_contract.reload: normally none; at most one deliberate clean reload per side for a stateful sequence

first_three_waves: After phase1 v004, inspect af26000e/af26000f/af260012 one boundary at a time.
Require source-like SVG shape/height/colors and no visible 1px paper/sage seam, clipping or overlap artifact from the restored -1px margin.
Do not infer seam correctness from CSS text alone.
FAQ_base: Before wave4, verify base FAQ/CTA has normal source section top+bottom rhythm from spacing-base-v002.
Do not treat the absence of the -24px wave-adjacent reduction as a defect before wave4 exists.
FAQ_wave4: After wave4 v002, take one tight source/target boundary pair covering the bottom of expectations, full wave and top of FAQ.
First decide seam geometry: no gap/clipping, source-like wave height/path.
Separately measure wave visual end -> FAQ eyebrow/H2 vertical rhythm.
FAQ_post_wave_top: If target vertical rhythm already equals source after wave4, record no-op PASS; do not append the top override.
Only a measured source/target residual matching the source 24px wave-adjacent reduction permits post-wave-top-v001.
After any top-only append, remeasure desktop and <=720; bottom spacing must remain unchanged.

other_measurement_no_write_rules: review natural image ratio alone is not defect; rendered media box decides
desktop 39px H2 is source-like; mobile winning computed value decides
hero CTA class strings are not acceptance; computed state decides
technology icon subject/order is protected until a concrete geometry delta is reproduced
hard structure cannot be declared exact from visual approximation
acceptance_rule: No PIXEL_PASS until required desktop/responsive section checks, wave/spacing decisions, semantic/runtime blockers and shared/global gates are freshly closed.
